name: UF-style-horror
note: horror — creepy and grotesque, locked to the 9-color BLOODMOON21 palette. 160x160. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/style-horror.  (sample: seed 1339)

form.subject: a (rotting scarecrow:1.3) with (glowing eyes:1.2) in a (cornfield at night:1.1)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (rotting scarecrow:1.3) with (glowing eyes:1.2) in a (cornfield at night:1.1)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)' --style horror --out 160x160 --palette BLOODMOON21 --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1339
